title: Compact Mirror Privacy Policy
htmlContent:
Compact Mirror (shown as Compact in the app) is provided by Scruffy Hipster Ltd. This policy explains how the iPhone and iPad app handles camera information, preferences, advertising, analytics and purchases.

Camera and Facial Features

Compact uses your front camera to show your reflection. Camera frames and facial landmarks are processed on your device to provide magnification, feature lock and stabilisation. They are not saved or uploaded, shared with advertising or analytics providers, or used to identify you.

The app requires camera permission to work as a mirror. It does not require an account, microphone access or photo-library access.

Information Stored on Your Device

Compact stores a small amount of app state locally so it can restore your choices, such as lighting intensity, warmth and mode, your chosen camera resolution, how many feature-lock trial uses you have had, and whether the mirror has been used for the first time. This information does not contain camera images or facial landmarks.

Advertising: Kickstart Exchange

The free version supports adverts through Kickstart Exchange, operated by Hudson Heavy Industries Ltd.

When an advert is shown, its SDK sends the integration key, bundle identifier, platform, app/build and SDK versions, and App Store storefront country. The country is your store account’s region, not GPS location. Kickstart records app-level advert impressions, clicks and reports to deliver and measure promotions and protect its service.

Shipping builds may send an Apple-signed App Transaction for installation verification. It can contain stable transaction and device-verification values; Kickstart says it immediately discards this evidence without retaining or using those values for identification or targeting.

Cloudflare processes connecting IP addresses to deliver and secure requests and advert artwork. Kickstart says it does not store those addresses, track people across apps or websites, or build behavioural profiles.

Individual advert records are retained for approximately 30 days; aggregate daily app-to-app statistics have no fixed deletion date. Tapping an advert opens its App Store page, which may include Apple campaign attribution tokens.

See the Kickstart Exchange privacy notice.

Product Analytics: TelemetryDeck

Compact uses TelemetryDeck to understand which features work well and where people encounter problems. Events include app sessions, mirror readiness, lighting, zoom and camera-resolution choices, feature lock and Light Box use, Settings and paywall interactions, purchase and restore outcomes, and broad error categories. Events may include technical app, operating-system and device information.

TelemetryDeck uses a hashed identifier for analytics. Compact does not supply your name, email address, camera frames, facial coordinates, continuous slider values or raw error messages.

Read TelemetryDeck’s privacy FAQ and privacy policy.

Purchases: Apple and RevenueCat

Compact uses Apple’s in-app purchase system and RevenueCat to provide, verify and restore premium access. RevenueCat processes an app user identifier, purchase receipts and transaction information, entitlement status, and technical device and app information. Apple handles payment; Compact does not receive your payment-card details.

Compact shares TelemetryDeck’s hashed identifier and app ID with RevenueCat so purchase events can be included in product analytics. Camera information is not included.

Read the RevenueCat privacy policy for provider information.

Sharing and Use

We use the information described above to operate the app, provide premium access, support app promotion and improve reliability. We do not sell your personal data or use your camera information to personalise adverts.

Service providers may process information outside your country. Their linked privacy notices describe their processing and safeguards.

Your Choices and Retention

You can revoke camera permission in iOS or iPadOS Settings. Premium access removes Kickstart Exchange advert banners. Removing adverts does not itself disable analytics or purchase verification.

Locally stored preferences remain until you remove the app’s local data. Uninstalling the app does not automatically erase purchase records held by Apple or service providers. Purchase information may be retained to restore access, resolve disputes and meet legal obligations; provider notices give further retention details.

Contact and Privacy Requests

If you contact support, we receive your email address and the information you choose to send. Please avoid sending camera images or other sensitive information unless needed for your request. We use support correspondence to respond and resolve the issue.

You can contact Scruffy Hipster Ltd at support@scruffyhipster.com with privacy questions or requests to access, correct or delete personal information. Depending on your location, you may also have rights to restrict or object to processing and to request data portability. You can complain to your local data-protection authority, including the UK Information Commissioner’s Office.

Changes to This Policy

We will update this page when our data practices change. The date above shows the latest revision.
